label: PILOT/DEVELOPMENT

kd.question: Does dependence between shared class decision coordinates transfer useful knowledge beyond direct similarity and matched BCE?
kd.variables: Each sample: logits minus class mean, then L2 normalization eps1e-8. Student/teacher in common100-class coordinates, no learned projection.

theory.Q: population marginal product estimated by ordered off-diagonal U-statistic, no label filtering
theory.J: EP(T-.5*T^2)-EQ(T+.5*T^2), exact batch first/second moments excluding diagonal
theory.warning: Centering/normalization changes measured variables and removes confidence scale; anchors still train logits. Not a claim that every task-relevant dependency must help.

kd.recipe: same FIT/CAL split and strict FIT WRN40-2 teacher; WRN16-2 student, batch64, SGD.05/momentum.9/wd.0005; DKD beta6/T4/warmup20.
kd.selection: each objective: max CAL top1, lower NLL, lower lambda; within run earliest best checkpoint; equal3-lambda budget for all3 auxiliary methods.

extension.explanation: Resource gate, not significance/noninferiority test. Extend only after all10 corresponding pilot units finish and identities match.
extension.arms: anchor + selected lambda of each of cosine/VCS/BCE; same seeds/init/schedule; no lambda re-selection on full seeds

kd.final_signal: VCS mean gain >=.2pp and >=2/3 seeds positive against anchor and each selected matched control; report full differences regardless of gate.
analyses: teacher-correct/anchor-wrong gains and teacher-wrong harms using matched CAL ids
auxiliary vs full-anchor logit gradients, saturation
all lambda histories and matched sample-order traces
limitations: CAL reused for pilot and full development; no independent confirmation.
Short pilot schedule differs from240epochs; all expansion claims conditional on this choice.

_publication_note: Public scientific protocol excerpt; not an operational freeze, source manifest or admission authorization.
